'''Stellan''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Stellan (species)|Stellan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], whose society was governed by a [[theocracy]]. Due to the species' religious beliefs, any Stellan deemed overly aggressive or a danger to their society was [[ter-Stellan|exiled]] from their planet and launched into its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] aboard [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].

[[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] and [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] from the worlds of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] consequently regularly visited Stellan's [[Stellan system/Legends|star system]] in order to rob or capture the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] natives. One such Stellan outcast was [[Jeigh Esse]], who instead joined a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Chattza clan/Legends|clan]] and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

==Description==
Stellan was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Magnificent" /> located in the [[Stellan system/Legends|Stellan system]],<ref name="TEA Stellan" /> deep within the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]]<ref name="Magnificent" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Stellan" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Magnificent" />

==History==
[[File:Stellan.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Stellan was the homeworld of the species of the same name, including the bounty hunter Jeigh Esse.]]
Stellan was a secluded, fiercely isolationist world that had severed nearly all connections to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. For [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] from the nearby<ref name="Magnificent" /> planets<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] regularly visited Stellan's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. There, they robbed or captured the members of the native [[Stellan (species)|Stellan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] by the planet's ruling [[theocracy]] and launched into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard [[Transport/Legends|migration transports]].<ref name="Magnificent" />

At one point, the [[Psychopathy|sociopathic]] Stellan teenager [[Jeigh Esse]], who had framed numerous other Stellan [[Youngling/Legends|children]] for her own misdeeds&mdash;resulting in their exile from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]&mdash;was herself sentenced to the same punishment, a fact that no Stellan on the planet regretted. As she was launched into space, the young [[Gender/Legends|girl]] laughed at her exile and vowed that the society on Stellan would one [[Local day/Legends|day]] succumb to the temptations of the local [[Deity/Legends|deity]] known as the [[Vain Goddess]] and [[Fire/Legends|burn]] as a result.<ref name="Magnificent" />

In Stellan's orbit, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] Esse was on was boarded by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and the outcast soon learned of the fate of the other exiled Stellan. The girl, however, fought off her would-be captors and was eventually accepted into the Rodian [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]], going on to become a ruthless [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="Magnificent" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Stellan (species)}}
Stellan was the homeworld of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Stellan species. The Stellan society led a [[Monk/Legends|monastic]] way of life, and it was ruled by a theocratic [[priest-king]]. Stellan religious beliefs maintained that if they were to give in to the temptations of the Vain Goddess inciting individuals to [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]], the [[Soul/Legends|soul]] of Stellan would be lost.<ref name="Magnificent" />

In order to preserve the moral purity of the Stellan society and prevent that from happening, all Stellan children were intensely screened at a very early age, and if seen as potential threat to said purity, were declared [[ter-Stellan]], or "Exiled Ones," along with criminals, individuals with [[Brain/Legends|mental]] disabilities deemed dangerous to others, and simply Stellan with overly aggressive natures. The ter-Stellan were then launched into Stellan's orbit aboard transport vessels, where their fate was left to the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Magnificent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stellan was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] article "[[The Not-So Magnificent Seven]]," authored by [[Greg Mitchell]] and published on [[September 4]], [[2013]].<ref name="Magnificent" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Stellan [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA Stellan" />
